items.evidence: Our Compensation Committee selects performance measures that it believes support our strategy
Cash flow generation is critical to achieving the Company's net debt reduction goals
Digital | Achieve a specified percentage of digital revenue growth, and enter into a minimum number of digital contracts
Sustainability | Establish industry-leading emissions reduction targets.
New Energy | Accelerate expansion of new energy portfolio, by establishing a specified number of carbon capture
Investor Relations | Attract increased investments from new investors
HSE | Achieve total recordable injury frequency and automotive accident rate per million miles below a target threshold.
Absolute FCF Margin PSUs: We replaced our previous free cash flow conversion rate metric
Relative TSR PSUs: We introduced PSUs based on a three-year relative TSR metric as a new element of our LTI program
Relative ROCE PSUs: We increased the rigor of the performance targets for our three-year relative return on capital employed
